values.quote: Implement a design approach velocity of up to 0.12 m/s if the ambient flow is at least twice the design approach velocity.
values.where: s.3.1.1; Table C-1 ('up to a maximum approach velocity of 0.12 m/s')

unsupported_wording: 'mitigation standard' - page calls it an 'interim mitigation procedure'. 'Approach velocity default ___-___ m/s' misstates it: the default is a single maximum (0.035 m/s in Table C-1, but 0.055 m/s in s.3.1.1 - the page contradicts itself), and 0.12 m/s is a conditional ceiling only where sweeping velocity is at least 2x the approach velocity. 'Openings <=' should note the 1 mm limit where eels/small SAR are present.
note: 'May not apply to large intakes' is supported: 'the methods specified in this mitigation procedure may not be applicable to large water intakes or high withdrawal rates.' Federal guidance; application depends on the authorizing instrument.
